item.title: Review: DoorDash to Buy Rival Instacart in $17 Billion Deal
item.description: DoorDash Inc. agreed to buy rival Instacart in a deal that values the company at about $17 billion. The transaction is expected to close near the end of next year, the deal is still pending. DoorDash says it will keep Instacart's brand, tech products and app. Bloomberg's Natalie Lung reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Review: DWS Americas CEO: Europe Is a Bet on a Physical Economy
item.description: DWS Americas CEO Hepsen Uzcan discusses whether investors are getting enough clarity from Kevin Warsh and other Fed members about monetary policy.
